callees.name: list_staged_domain_knowledge_relpaths
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a writable directory that may contain staged domain knowledge files under its spec_prompts/domain_context/user_knowledge/ subdirectory
callees.post_condition: Returns a sorted list of relative path strings from the workspace root to every user-provided domain knowledge markdown file staged under work_dir. Returns an empty list if no files are staged.

callees.name: format_domain_knowledge_bullets
callees.pre_condition: paths is a non-empty list of relative path strings to markdown files
callees.post_condition: Returns a string where each path in the input list is formatted as a bullet point with a workspace-relative prefix, suitable for injection into an agent instruction prompt.
